contexts.text: Abraham and Keturah = the Lord as to the Divine Spiritual. Explained.
Abraham's woman (Keturah) represents the Lord as to Divine truth adjoined to Divine spiritual good. Explained.
Her name was Keturah () = the essence of this Divine truth.

All these were the sons of Keturah () = as to doctrinal things and the worships thence... Keturah represents Divine spiritual truth conjoined with Divine spiritual good; thus the things which are of the Lord's Spiritual Kingdom, the worship of which is according to doctrinal things...
